WHERE year IS NOT NULL ORDER BY year DESC

SELECT DISTINCT country FROM
WHERE country IS NOT NULL AND country != '' ORDER BY country ASC

SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN
THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completeCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN
THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2) AS completeRate, ROUND(AVG(happiness_score), 3) AS avgScore, ROUND(MAX(happiness_score), 3) AS maxScore, ROUND(MIN(happiness_score), 3) AS minScore, ROUND(AVG(rank_in_year), 2) AS avgRank, ROUND(AVG(explained_log_gdp_per_capita), 3) AS avgGdp, ROUND(AVG(explained_social_support), 3) AS avgSocialSupport, ROUND(AVG(explained_healthy_life_expectancy), 3) AS avgHealthyLife, ROUND(AVG(explained_freedom), 3) AS avgFreedom, ROUND(AVG(explained_generosity), 3) AS avgGenerosity, ROUND(AVG(explained_corruption), 3) AS avgCorruption, ROUND(AVG(dystopia_plus_residual), 3) AS avgResidual FROM

SELECT segmentName, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(COUNT(1) * 100 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM (SELECT * FROM `visualization_project`.`world_happiness_report` ) total_t WHERE total_t.happiness_score IS NOT NULL), 0), 2) AS ratio, ROUND(AVG(happiness_score), 3) AS avgScore, ROUND(AVG(rank_in_year), 2) AS avgRank, ROUND(AVG(explained_log_gdp_per_capita), 3) AS avgGdp, ROUND(AVG(explained_social_support), 3) AS avgSocialSupport, ROUND(AVG(explained_healthy_life_expectancy), 3) AS avgHealthyLife, ROUND(AVG(explained_freedom), 3) AS avgFreedom, ROUND(AVG(explained_generosity), 3) AS avgGenerosity, ROUND(AVG(explained_corruption), 3) AS avgCorruption, ROUND(AVG(dystopia_plus_residual), 3) AS avgResidual FROM ( SELECT t.*, CASE WHEN t.happiness_score < 4 THEN '4分以下' WHEN t.happiness_score < 5 THEN '4-5分' WHEN t.happiness_score < 6 THEN '5-6分' WHEN t.happiness_score < 7 THEN '6-7分' ELSE '7分及以上' END AS segmentName, CASE WHEN t.happiness_score < 4 THEN 1 WHEN t.happiness_score < 5 THEN 2 WHEN t.happiness_score < 6 THEN 3 WHEN t.happiness_score < 7 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS sortNo FROM ( SELECT * FROM
) t WHERE t.happiness_score IS NOT NULL ) s GROUP BY segmentName, sortNo ORDER BY sortNo ASC

SELECT segmentName, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(AVG(happiness_score), 3) AS avgScore, ROUND(AVG(explained_log_gdp_per_capita), 3) AS avgGdp, ROUND(AVG(explained_social_support), 3) AS avgSocialSupport, ROUND(AVG(explained_healthy_life_expectancy), 3) AS avgHealthyLife, ROUND(AVG(explained_freedom), 3) AS avgFreedom, ROUND(AVG(explained_generosity), 3) AS avgGenerosity, ROUND(AVG(explained_corruption), 3) AS avgCorruption FROM ( SELECT t.*, CASE WHEN t.rank_in_year <= 10 THEN 'TOP10' WHEN t.rank_in_year <= 30 THEN '11-30名' WHEN t.rank_in_year <= 60 THEN '31-60名' WHEN t.rank_in_year <= 100 THEN '61-100名' ELSE '100名以后' END AS segmentName, CASE WHEN t.rank_in_year <= 10 THEN 1 WHEN t.rank_in_year <= 30 THEN 2 WHEN t.rank_in_year <= 60 THEN 3 WHEN t.rank_in_year <= 100 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS sortNo FROM ( SELECT * FROM
) t WHERE t.rank_in_year IS NOT NULL AND t.happiness_score IS NOT NULL ) s GROUP BY segmentName, sortNo ORDER BY sortNo ASC

SELECT year AS yearName, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(AVG(happiness_score), 3) AS avgScore, ROUND(AVG(rank_in_year), 2) AS avgRank, ROUND(AVG(explained_log_gdp_per_capita), 3) AS avgGdp, ROUND(AVG(explained_social_support), 3) AS avgSocialSupport, ROUND(AVG(explained_healthy_life_expectancy), 3) AS avgHealthyLife, ROUND(AVG(explained_freedom), 3) AS avgFreedom FROM ( SELECT * FROM
) t WHERE year IS NOT NULL AND happiness_score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY year ORDER BY year ASC

SELECT '人均GDP' AS factorName, ROUND(AVG(explained_log_gdp_per_capita), 3) AS avgValue, COUNT(explained_log_gdp_per_capita) AS validCount FROM (SELECT * FROM ) t UNION ALL SELECT '社会支持' AS factorName, ROUND(AVG(explained_social_support), 3) AS avgValue, COUNT(explained_social_support) AS validCount FROM (SELECT * FROM ) t UNION ALL SELECT '健康寿命' AS factorName, ROUND(AVG(explained_healthy_life_expectancy), 3) AS avgValue, COUNT(explained_healthy_life_expectancy) AS validCount FROM (SELECT * FROM ) t UNION ALL SELECT '自由度' AS factorName, ROUND(AVG(explained_freedom), 3) AS avgValue, COUNT(explained_freedom) AS validCount FROM (SELECT * FROM ) t UNION ALL SELECT '慷慨程度' AS factorName, ROUND(AVG(explained_generosity), 3) AS avgValue, COUNT(explained_generosity) AS validCount FROM (SELECT * FROM ) t UNION ALL SELECT '腐败感知' AS factorName, ROUND(AVG(explained_corruption), 3) AS avgValue, COUNT(explained_corruption) AS validCount FROM (SELECT * FROM ) t UNION ALL SELECT '残差项' AS factorName, ROUND(AVG(dystopia_plus_residual), 3) AS avgValue, COUNT(dystopia_plus_residual) AS validCount FROM (SELECT * FROM ) t

SELECT country, year, rank_in_year AS rankInYear, ROUND(happiness_score, 3) AS happinessScore, ROUND(explained_log_gdp_per_capita, 3) AS gdp, ROUND(explained_social_support, 3) AS socialSupport, ROUND(explained_healthy_life_expectancy, 3) AS healthyLife, ROUND(explained_freedom, 3) AS freedom FROM ( SELECT * FROM
) t WHERE happiness_score IS NOT NULL AND country IS NOT NULL AND country != '' ORDER BY happiness_score DESC, rank_in_year ASC LIMIT 15

SELECT country, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, MAX(year) AS latestYear, ROUND(AVG(happiness_score), 3) AS avgScore, ROUND(AVG(rank_in_year), 2) AS avgRank, ROUND(AVG(explained_log_gdp_per_capita), 3) AS avgGdp, ROUND(AVG(explained_social_support), 3) AS avgSocialSupport, ROUND(AVG(explained_healthy_life_expectancy), 3) AS avgHealthyLife, ROUND(AVG(explained_freedom), 3) AS avgFreedom FROM ( SELECT * FROM
) t WHERE happiness_score IS NOT NULL AND country IS NOT NULL AND country != '' GROUP BY country ORDER BY avgScore DESC, avgRank ASC LIMIT 15

SELECT segmentName, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(AVG(happiness_score), 3) AS avgScore, ROUND(AVG(explained_log_gdp_per_capita), 3) AS avgGdp, ROUND(AVG(explained_social_support), 3) AS avgSocialSupport, ROUND(AVG(explained_healthy_life_expectancy), 3) AS avgHealthyLife, ROUND(AVG(explained_freedom), 3) AS avgFreedom, ROUND(AVG(explained_generosity), 3) AS avgGenerosity, ROUND(AVG(explained_corruption), 3) AS avgCorruption, ROUND(AVG(dystopia_plus_residual), 3) AS avgResidual FROM ( SELECT t.*, CASE WHEN t.happiness_score < 5 THEN '低幸福组' WHEN t.happiness_score < 6.5 THEN '中等幸福组' ELSE '高幸福组' END AS segmentName, CASE WHEN t.happiness_score < 5 THEN 1 WHEN t.happiness_score < 6.5 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END AS sortNo FROM ( SELECT * FROM
) t WHERE t.happiness_score IS NOT NULL ) s GROUP BY segmentName, sortNo ORDER BY sortNo ASC

SELECT country, year, rank_in_year AS rankInYear, ROUND(happiness_score, 3) AS happinessScore, ROUND(explained_log_gdp_per_capita, 3) AS gdp, ROUND(explained_social_support, 3) AS socialSupport, ROUND(explained_healthy_life_expectancy, 3) AS healthyLife, ROUND(explained_freedom, 3) AS freedom, ROUND(explained_generosity, 3) AS generosity, ROUND(explained_corruption, 3) AS corruption FROM ( SELECT * FROM
) t WHERE happiness_score IS NOT NULL ORDER BY year DESC, happiness_score DESC LIMIT 300

) t WHERE t.year IS NOT NULL AND t.happiness_score IS NOT NULL ) s GROUP BY yearName, segmentName, sortNo ORDER BY yearName ASC, sortNo ASC
